messages:
lia: FYI I'm opening a PR to refresh the 'hello-mini' quickstart. Main goals: simplify auth flow, unify Node/Python snippets to SDK v6, and tighten the first-deploy checklist. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234

samir: thanks! can you call out where the credential helper is now? the old snippet used a `TOKEN` env var and we need to recommend `REDWOOD_API_KEY` for hosted users.

lia: good catch — plan is to add an explicit note: 
- hosted: `REDWOOD_API_KEY`
- private/dedicated: `REDWOOD_TOKEN` (examples kept for ops)

cameron: skimmed the diff. the Docker section got much shorter, nice. one ask: can we keep a one-line migration note for customers moving from SDK v4 -> v6? just to highlight rename of `RedwoodClient` -> `Redwood` and new `stream` option.

jordan: pinging @lia re: sample auth snippet, also saw a broken link in the current quickstart to the token FAQ. path in repo is docs/token-mgmt.md -> it should be docs/auth/tokens.md in the new tree.

docs-bot: Preview for PR #1234 deployed: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/hello-mini (checks: spell, links, preview-site) :white_check_mark:

lia: pushing a small commit to fix that link and add the migration note. also replacing the old `export TOKEN=...` snippet with this: 
```bash
# hosted (recommended)
export REDWOOD_API_KEY="sk-..."
# private/dedicated (legacy env name supported)
export REDWOOD_TOKEN="rt-..."
```

samir: linter flagged an inline code style issue in the Node example (missing backticks around template literal). I'll open a tiny follow-up commit unless you want it in this PR.

devex-bot: docs lint report: 2 warnings, 1 error (codeblock language mismatch in `hello-mini/node/snippet.md`). See checks.

cameron: CI failed on the snippet validation step: 
```
ERROR: snip-runner failed at hello-mini/node/snippet.md:14 - Uncaught ReferenceError: Redwood is not defined
```

lia: ah — I accidentally left the `const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference')` import out of the Node snippet. fixing now.

jordan: for reviewers — I can take the snippets, @cameron can you do the deployment checklist? @samir can you double-check the auth wording?

cameron: will do checklist + smoke test on local container. estimate end of day.

samir: I'll re-review the auth text & token docs in ~2 hours.

docs-bot: CI: all checks passed for PR #1234 (after fixes) :white_check_mark:

gh-actions: merged PR #1234 into main by cameron — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/abcdef1234 :tada:

lia: thanks all! will follow up with a short changelog entry and a quick note in the #all-hands docs roundup. :thumbsup:

cameron: nice work. moving to close the follow-ups. :rocket:
